item.title: Medline Industries, LP: Medline Convenience Kits: 1) DYKM1000B, Catalog Number: DYKM1000B; 2) DYKM2187A, Catalog Number: DYKM2187A Recall
item.product: Medline Convenience Kits: 1) DYKM1000B, Catalog Number: DYKM1000B; 2) DYKM2187A, Catalog Number: DYKM2187A
item.summary: The kits contain certain lots of sterile applicators which may contain fungal contamination that may occur under certain environmental conditions, allowing the growth of Aspergillus penicillioides. Contamination of skin preparation products with Aspergillus penicillioides may lead to serious adverse health consequences, including systemic infection, sepsis, illness, and death.
